column1: # Agent SQL corpus of the postgresql language: the ANSI SQL that two models wrote for 40 questions about an LDBC SNB slice, one statement
# per generation, nothing deduplicated and nothing filtered (correct, incorrect and unscored ones). Fork issue #7 (the roadmap of
# constructs the generated SQL needs) and the measurement of the pull request that adds it. The file has the columns of syntax.tsv,
# so the harness reads and regenerates it the same way, plus three at the end. See syntax.tsv for the first seven.
# Source of the statements: the experiment sql-evidence of humemai/arcadedb-embedded-python at commit ce4ed5e9327f (harness, frozen
# prompts and questions), run gen-1 of 2026-11-04: 40 questions (A01 to A10 one type, B01 to B10 one join, C01 to C10 several
# joins, D01 to D10 graph pattern, asked here in ANSI SQL), two models (claude-sonnet-5-5 and claude-haiku-5-5), three samples,
# one request per generation (the custom_id r0000 to r1199 of the batch). The prompt is prompts/sql.txt of the experiment, with the
# schema in agent-sql-schema.sql. The text is the extraction of the experiment (the code fence removed, trimmed), unchanged.
#   subset     unknown for every entry: only the pg18 column is checked, the parser test measures and never fails on the subset
#   source     sql-evidence <commit of the experiment> <custom_id of the request>
#   pg18       what PostgreSQL 18 does with the statement in its parser, as for syntax.tsv, with the tables of agent-sql-schema.sql
#              loaded in the server (a statement is parsed and described, never run). The generator writes it, nobody types it
#   detail     as for syntax.tsv: the SQLSTATE of the server, - when it accepted the statement without an error
#   group      the category of the question: single, join, multi_join or graph (all four were asked in SQL)
#   duckdb     the verdict of the experiment (score.py on DuckDB, the rows compared with the reference rows): correct, incorrect, or
#              unscored (the question D03 is unscored in every arm because its gold did not verify, so there is no verdict)
